Tasks derived from public commits or PRs may already exist in pretraining data.

div.div:
Narrow task scope
Prompts can be long and prescriptive while the actual implementation change stays small.

Prompts, verifiers, and reference solutions are written from scratch and not merged upstream.

113 tasks span 91 repositories and 5 languages, limiting overfitting to a few famous codebases.

Create the prompt, handwritten verifier, and reference solution from scratch.

Shorter prompts force codebase discovery, design judgment, and regression avoidance.

Repeat runs, regression checks, and review reduce flaky or overfit scoring.
